Taylor (AE): Heads-up: sending HelixCare RFI at 15:00 PT. Quick preflight — include capability matrix, short PoC options (3wk/6wk), pricing sample rows, and a one-paragraph security caveat about BYOK/HSM.
Jordan (Solutions): I'll add a 'fallbacks' column and a weighted score for cost vs latency. Also include a quantization caveat cell.
Priya (Security): Draft blurb: "Redwood supports BYOK via standard KMS integrations (AWS/GCP/Azure). For Private/on-prem installs we support HSM-backed keys with attestation and rotation logs; hosted BYOK available via our KMS bridge. We can produce a controls-mapping on request." Paste to security-note.txt.
Omar (Ops): PoC gating: request their cloud account IDs + IAM role and confirm GPU quota. I'll add a peering sketch and expected egress estimates to the PoC appendix.
Taylor (AE): Perfect. Jordan — add two sample commit tiers to pricing CSV (100k/day and 1M/day) with burst notes.
Jordan (Solutions): Done. Snippet added to PoC appendix for embedding config: ```model: redwood-base-2
quantize: int8
batch_max_tokens: 1024
cache_prefix: true```
rfi-bot: Attachments uploaded: capability_matrix_helix.xlsx, helix-rfi-answers.pdf, pricing-sample.csv, poc-options.md, security-note.txt. SHA256: d4b8...a72.
Taylor (AE): I'll send at 15:00. If anything changes ping me directly. :thumbsup:
